method.change: Exact tare constraints scoped to provenance+shade+vintage, never the shared curve. Local curves activated only from training pure-tare comparison inputs; shrink to shared context curve. Unobserved local contexts use shared curve.
method.validation: Same five seeds/outer withheld families and ORIGINAL TRAINING-SELECTED per-fold hyperparameters as contextual v7. Fixed-settings scope ablation, not a separately hyperparameter-tuned contender. Local contexts/constraints discovered inside training fold only.
method.constraints: Nonnegative tare steps and full-grid weak shade/age monotonicity. Only exact pure-tare ties are hard constraints; ranking loss remains soft.
method.limits: More parameters; exploratory use of known evidence. New prospective validation needed before promotion. Context transfer is soft, not proof every unobserved provenance shares a plateau.
